summary: 3D Tamil Nadu Car Game (தமிழ்நாடு 3D கார் பயணம் & பந்தயம்) implementation plan covering the 5 iconic Tamil Nadu regions & landmarks (Chennai Marina, Thanjavur Brihadeeswarar Temple, Madurai Meenakshi Temple, Ooty Hairpin Hills, Kanyakumari Thiruvalluvar Statue), 3 composite 3D vehicles with full customization garage, Free Roam & Time Trial modes, bilingual Tamil/English UI, and multi-station procedural Tamil traditional & racing synth radio.
